title: Teleprompter operator scandal is another example of the value of inside information

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Teleprompter operator scandal is another example of the value of inside information
sources.description: The report that Gabriel Perez, President Trump's teleprompter operator, was allegedly using his knowledge of the contents of speeches to make prediction-market wagers on Kalshi is a symptom, not the disease.
